items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I used him on the Hoagy Carmichael album. I used to play with him in the Spanish bands

ctx.x: Art Pepper was a marvelous player, I used him on the Hoagy Carmichael album. I used to play with him in the Spanish bands, you know when I was playing in the Latin bands. We called them Spanish bands, they weren’t Spanish, they were Puerto Rican or Cuban, that was in the late 40s.
How well did you get to know him?
